responsibility: This file implements libgccjit’s scratch-directory lifecycle for on-disk intermediates. It creates a private temporary directory and standard fake source/assembly/shared-object paths, using mkdtemp and libiberty tempdir selection on non-Windows hosts or delegating to Windows helpers when needed, and on destruction it either reports preserved intermediates or unlinks generated files and removes the directory. It therefore owns the concrete filesystem management behind jit::tempdir during JIT compilation and compile-to-file workflows.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-tempdir.h, which declares the tempdir helper and its path/tempfile APIs, this same-stem .c file performs the platform-specific filesystem work of creating the scratch directory and standard fake paths, then either preserving or unlinking intermediates and removing the directory on destruction.
